name: Sweden
standard: EN 301 549 (WCAG 2.1 AA), via DIGG regulations MDFFS 2019:2

laws.cite: Lag (2018:1937) om tillgänglighet till digital offentlig service (DOS-lagen)
laws.summary: Public actors' websites and apps must be accessible and carry an accessibility statement.
Implementing ordinance that names the supervisory authority.

applies_to: State and municipal authorities, municipal and regional decision-making assemblies, publicly controlled bodies, and some private actors in education and health care.
mobile: explicit — the law covers websites and mobile applications.
enforcement: DIGG (Agency for Digital Government) supervises and issues regulations; users can report to DIGG after an unsatisfactory reply.
notes: The Riksdagen URLs came from search results and were not opened. DIGG's specific powers (injunctions, fines) are not confirmed here.
